Build an Android app for nurses at a small clinic to track antenatal care
(ANC) visits.

1. **Register screen:** a list of currently pregnant patients showing name,
   age, estimated due date, and current weeks of pregnancy, sorted by due
   date (soonest first).
2. Tapping a patient opens a **patient detail screen** showing her past ANC
   visits: date, weight, blood pressure, and hemoglobin if recorded.
3. From the detail screen the nurse can **record a new ANC visit** by
   filling a form with: visit date, gestational age in weeks, weight (kg),
   systolic and diastolic blood pressure (mmHg), any danger signs (none /
   vaginal bleeding / severe headache / blurred vision / fever, multiple
   allowed), and free-text notes.
4. Saving the form persists the visit; it appears in the patient's visit
   list and survives app restart.

The clinic already has these three patients on file, each with one prior
visit:

| Name | Date of birth | Est. due date | Last visit | Weight | BP | Hb |

| Emily Carter | 1996-04-12 | 2026-12-05 | 2026-08-10 | 68.5 kg | 118/76 | 11.8 g/dL |
| Sarah Mitchell | 1990-11-02 | 2027-01-20 | 2026-08-12 | 61.2 kg | 110/70 | 12.4 g/dL |
| Grace Thompson | 2001-07-30 | 2026-10-15 | 2026-08-05 | 72.0 kg | 128/84 | 10.2 g/dL |

Use whatever architecture, libraries, data model, and storage you think are
best. The three existing patients above should be present in the app as
starting data.

Before you consider the task finished, make the app actually build and run.
Compile it with `./gradlew assembleDebug` and fix every error until the build
succeeds. Then, if an Android emulator is connected (check `adb devices`),
install and launch the app, confirm it opens to its main screen without
crashing, and check `adb logcat` for runtime errors. Do not report the task
as done until the app compiles and runs.

package com.example.ancapp.data

import android.content.ContentValues
import android.content.Context
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteOpenHelper
import com.example.ancapp.model.AncVisit
import com.example.ancapp.model.DangerSign
import com.example.ancapp.model.Patient
import com.example.ancapp.model.PatientWithVisits
import java.time.LocalDate

class AncDatabaseHelper(context: Context) :
  SQLiteOpenHelper(context.applicationContext, DATABASE_NAME, null, DATABASE_VERSION) {

  override fun onConfigure(db: SQLiteDatabase) {
    super.onConfigure(db)
    db.setForeignKeyConstraintsEnabled(true)
  }

  override fun onCreate(db: SQLiteDatabase) {
    db.execSQL(
      """
      CREATE TABLE $TABLE_PATIENTS (
        $COL_PATIENT_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        $COL_PATIENT_NAME TEXT NOT NULL,
        $COL_PATIENT_DOB TEXT NOT NULL,
        $COL_PATIENT_EDD TEXT NOT NULL
      )
      """.trimIndent()
    )

    db.execSQL(
      """
      CREATE TABLE $TABLE_VISITS (
        $COL_VISIT_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        $COL_VISIT_PATIENT_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
        $COL_VISIT_DATE TEXT NOT NULL,
        $COL_VISIT_GA_WEEKS INTEGER NOT NULL,
        $COL_VISIT_WEIGHT_KG REAL NOT NULL,
        $COL_VISIT_SYSTOLIC_BP INTEGER NOT NULL,
        $COL_VISIT_DIASTOLIC_BP INTEGER NOT NULL,
        $COL_VISIT_HEMOGLOBIN REAL,
        $COL_VISIT_DANGER_SIGNS TEXT NOT NULL,
        $COL_VISIT_NOTES TEXT NOT NULL,
        FOREIGN KEY($COL_VISIT_PATIENT_ID) REFERENCES $TABLE_PATIENTS($COL_PATIENT_ID) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )
      """.trimIndent()
    )

    seedInitialData(db)
  }

  override fun onUpgrade(db: SQLiteDatabase, oldVersion: Int, newVersion: Int) {
    db.execSQL("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS $TABLE_VISITS")
    db.execSQL("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS $TABLE_PATIENTS")
    onCreate(db)
  }

  private fun seedInitialData(db: SQLiteDatabase) {
    data class SeedRecord(
      val name: String,
      val dob: String,
      val edd: String,
      val visitDate: String,
      val weightKg: Double,
      val systolic: Int,
      val diastolic: Int,
      val hb: Double
    )

    val initialRecords = listOf(
      SeedRecord(
        name = "Emily Carter",
        dob = "1996-04-12",
        edd = "2026-12-05",
        visitDate = "2026-08-10",
        weightKg = 68.5,
        systolic = 118,
        diastolic = 76,
        hb = 11.8
      ),
      SeedRecord(
        name = "Sarah Mitchell",
        dob = "1990-11-02",
        edd = "2027-01-20",
        visitDate = "2026-08-12",
        weightKg = 61.2,
        systolic = 110,
        diastolic = 70,
        hb = 12.4
      ),
      SeedRecord(
        name = "Grace Thompson",
        dob = "2001-07-30",
        edd = "2026-10-15",
        visitDate = "2026-08-05",
        weightKg = 72.0,
        systolic = 128,
        diastolic = 84,
        hb = 10.2
      )
    )

    for (record in initialRecords) {
      val patientValues = ContentValues().apply {
        put(COL_PATIENT_NAME, record.name)
        put(COL_PATIENT_DOB, record.dob)
        put(COL_PATIENT_EDD, record.edd)
      }
      val patientId = db.insert(TABLE_PATIENTS, null, patientValues)

      val eddDate = LocalDate.parse(record.edd)
      val visitLocalDate = LocalDate.parse(record.visitDate)
      val gaWeeks = Patient.calculateGestationalWeeks(eddDate, visitLocalDate)

      val visitValues = ContentValues().apply {
        put(COL_VISIT_PATIENT_ID, patientId)
        put(COL_VISIT_DATE, record.visitDate)
        put(COL_VISIT_GA_WEEKS, gaWeeks)
        put(COL_VISIT_WEIGHT_KG, record.weightKg)
        put(COL_VISIT_SYSTOLIC_BP, record.systolic)
        put(COL_VISIT_DIASTOLIC_BP, record.diastolic)
        put(COL_VISIT_HEMOGLOBIN, record.hb)
        put(COL_VISIT_DANGER_SIGNS, DangerSign.NONE.name)
        put(COL_VISIT_NOTES, "Initial clinic visit on file.")
      }
      db.insert(TABLE_VISITS, null, visitValues)
    }
  }

  fun getAllPatientsSortedByDueDate(): List<PatientWithVisits> {
    val db = writableDatabase
    val patients = mutableListOf<Patient>()

    db.query(
      TABLE_PATIENTS,
      arrayOf(COL_PATIENT_ID, COL_PATIENT_NAME, COL_PATIENT_DOB, COL_PATIENT_EDD),
      null,
      null,
      null,
      null,
      "$COL_PATIENT_EDD ASC, $COL_PATIENT_NAME ASC"
    ).use { cursor ->
      val idIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_PATIENT_ID)
      val nameIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_PATIENT_NAME)
      val dobIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_PATIENT_DOB)
      val eddIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_PATIENT_EDD)

      while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
        patients.add(
          Patient(
            id = cursor.getLong(idIdx),
            name = cursor.getString(nameIdx),
            dateOfBirth = LocalDate.parse(cursor.getString(dobIdx)),
            estimatedDueDate = LocalDate.parse(cursor.getString(eddIdx))
          )
        )
      }
    }

    return patients
      .sortedWith(compareBy<Patient> { it.estimatedDueDate }.thenBy { it.name })
      .map { patient ->
        PatientWithVisits(
          patient = patient,
          visits = getVisitsForPatient(db, patient.id)
        )
      }
  }

  fun getPatientWithVisits(patientId: Long): PatientWithVisits? {
    val db = readableDatabase
    var patient: Patient? = null

    db.query(
      TABLE_PATIENTS,
      arrayOf(COL_PATIENT_ID, COL_PATIENT_NAME, COL_PATIENT_DOB, COL_PATIENT_EDD),
      "$COL_PATIENT_ID = ?",
      arrayOf(patientId.toString()),
      null,
      null,
      null
    ).use { cursor ->
      if (cursor.moveToFirst()) {
        patient = Patient(
          id = cursor.getLong(cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_PATIENT_ID)),
          name = cursor.getString(cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_PATIENT_NAME)),
          dateOfBirth = LocalDate.parse(cursor.getString(cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_PATIENT_DOB))),
          estimatedDueDate = LocalDate.parse(cursor.getString(cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_PATIENT_EDD)))
        )
      }
    }

    val foundPatient = patient ?: return null
    val visits = getVisitsForPatient(db, foundPatient.id)
    return PatientWithVisits(foundPatient, visits)
  }

  private fun getVisitsForPatient(db: SQLiteDatabase, patientId: Long): List<AncVisit> {
    val visits = mutableListOf<AncVisit>()
    db.query(
      TABLE_VISITS,
      null,
      "$COL_VISIT_PATIENT_ID = ?",
      arrayOf(patientId.toString()),
      null,
      null,
      "$COL_VISIT_DATE DESC, $COL_VISIT_ID DESC"
    ).use { cursor ->
      val idIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_VISIT_ID)
      val patIdIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_VISIT_PATIENT_ID)
      val dateIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_VISIT_DATE)
      val gaIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_VISIT_GA_WEEKS)
      val weightIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_VISIT_WEIGHT_KG)
      val sysIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_VISIT_SYSTOLIC_BP)
      val diaIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_VISIT_DIASTOLIC_BP)
      val hbIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_VISIT_HEMOGLOBIN)
      val signsIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_VISIT_DANGER_SIGNS)
      val notesIdx = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(COL_VISIT_NOTES)

      while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
        val hb = if (cursor.isNull(hbIdx)) null else cursor.getDouble(hbIdx)
        visits.add(
          AncVisit(
            id = cursor.getLong(idIdx),
            patientId = cursor.getLong(patIdIdx),
            visitDate = LocalDate.parse(cursor.getString(dateIdx)),
            gestationalAgeWeeks = cursor.getInt(gaIdx),
            weightKg = cursor.getDouble(weightIdx),
            systolicBp = cursor.getInt(sysIdx),
            diastolicBp = cursor.getInt(diaIdx),
            hemoglobinGdl = hb,
            dangerSigns = DangerSign.deserializeList(cursor.getString(signsIdx)),
            notes = cursor.getString(notesIdx) ?: ""
          )
        )
      }
    }
    return visits
  }

  fun insertVisit(visit: AncVisit): Long {
    val db = writableDatabase
    val values = ContentValues().apply {
      put(COL_VISIT_PATIENT_ID, visit.patientId)
      put(COL_VISIT_DATE, visit.visitDate.toString())
      put(COL_VISIT_GA_WEEKS, visit.gestationalAgeWeeks)
      put(COL_VISIT_WEIGHT_KG, visit.weightKg)
      put(COL_VISIT_SYSTOLIC_BP, visit.systolicBp)
      put(COL_VISIT_DIASTOLIC_BP, visit.diastolicBp)
      if (visit.hemoglobinGdl != null) {
        put(COL_VISIT_HEMOGLOBIN, visit.hemoglobinGdl)
      } else {
        putNull(COL_VISIT_HEMOGLOBIN)
      }
      put(COL_VISIT_DANGER_SIGNS, DangerSign.serializeList(visit.dangerSigns))
      put(COL_VISIT_NOTES, visit.notes.trim())
    }
    return db.insertOrThrow(TABLE_VISITS, null, values)
  }

  companion object {
    private const val DATABASE_NAME = "anc_clinic.db"
    private const val DATABASE_VERSION = 1

    const val TABLE_PATIENTS = "patients"
    const val COL_PATIENT_ID = "id"
    const val COL_PATIENT_NAME = "name"
    const val COL_PATIENT_DOB = "date_of_birth"
    const val COL_PATIENT_EDD = "estimated_due_date"

    const val TABLE_VISITS = "anc_visits"
    const val COL_VISIT_ID = "id"
    const val COL_VISIT_PATIENT_ID = "patient_id"
    const val COL_VISIT_DATE = "visit_date"
    const val COL_VISIT_GA_WEEKS = "gestational_age_weeks"
    const val COL_VISIT_WEIGHT_KG = "weight_kg"
    const val COL_VISIT_SYSTOLIC_BP = "systolic_bp"
    const val COL_VISIT_DIASTOLIC_BP = "diastolic_bp"
    const val COL_VISIT_HEMOGLOBIN = "hemoglobin_gdl"
    const val COL_VISIT_DANGER_SIGNS = "danger_signs"
    const val COL_VISIT_NOTES = "notes"

    @Volatile
    private var instance: AncDatabaseHelper? = null

    fun getInstance(context: Context): AncDatabaseHelper {
      return instance ?: synchronized(this) {
        instance ?: AncDatabaseHelper(context).also { instance = it }
      }
    }
  }
}
